semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides high-purity fluoropolymer solutions and contamination control products relevant to semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Nanjing Binzhenghong Instrument Co., Ltd specializes in high-performance fluoropolymer solutions, particularly PFA, PTFE, and FEP, for laboratory and industrial applications.
